output.brief: The complaints look like a brake-fluid problem, not a driving or pad problem. Eastgate vans serviced at Northfield Motor Services during the bay closure got fluid from a bulk drum that had been opened in March, lost its cap, and had taken on water. Two vans checked on warranty read 149–152°C boiling point against 255°C for sealed fluid, and their soft pedals were fixed by renewing the fluid. All 11 Eastgate vans with brake complaints came from that Northfield group. Drivers' non-Northfield vans, including Upper Wend runs, produced no reports, and Tessaro pads on Calder Road vans caused none. I am fairly confident, but the 11 bulk-drum vans have not been tested yet. This week: take the Northfield-serviced vans out of service until their fluid is boiling-point tested and renewed from sealed stock, and recall Okafor's 25 Sep recheck request. Do not discipline drivers or launch retraining. Do not switch pad suppliers. Confirm the pattern with the boiling-point tests.
